fields.summary: Autonomous plan run (no owner present) for the bug where the docs workflow declares [autonomy] signoff = owner, yet run 01M73CQ4D71CW038ZBNSQB1SJF signed off under rule autonomous. Findings: the run's journal recorded the signoff stage as owner from workflow docs, but internal/run/signoff.go signs off whenever State.Autonomous is set and never reads the recorded stage autonomy; the only guard is daemonStart dropping --autonomous, which other start paths bypass. Planned one leaf: the signoff step itself waits for the owner when the run's recorded signoff stage is a workflow-declared owner, even in an autonomous run, so every start path honours it. Served intent follows the precedent of recent run fixes (m4-runs-hold-up). Setting-sourced signoff = owner keeps today's handling (the daemon starts without --autonomous); no owner words were quoted because there was no owner.
fields.title: Plan: workflow-declared signoff owner beats --autonomous
